You see a boat filled with people. It has not sunk. But when you look back, you don’t see a single person on the boat. Why?
Riddles.a: All the people on board are married.

Riddles.q: What is it that no one wants to have, but no one wants to lose either?

What goes through cities and fields, but never moves?
What can be touched but can't be seen?
In a bus, there is a 26-year-old pregnant lady, a 30-year-old policeman, a 52-year-old random woman, and the driver who is 65 years old. Who is the youngest?
Riddles.a: The baby of the pregnant lady.

Riddles.q: When it is alive we sing, when it is dead we clap our hands. What is it?
What can go through glass without breaking it?
What gets bigger the more you take away?

What kind of room has no walls, door or windows?

What two things can you never eat for breakfast?
I make a loud sound when I’m changing. When I do change, I get bigger but weigh less. What am I?
I’m orange, I wear a green hat and I sound like a parrot. What am I?
What runs all around a backyard, yet never moves?
Take off my skin — I won't cry, but you will! What am I?
What invention lets you look right through a wall?
What is always on its way but never arrives?
Two girls were born to the same mother, on the same day, at the same time, in the same month and year, and yet they're not twins. How can this be?
Riddles.a: The two babies are two of a set of triplets.

Riddles.q: What has a bottom at the top?

If an electric train is traveling south, then which way is the smoke going?
Riddles.a: There is no smoke — it's an electric train.

What can you put in a bucket to make it weigh less?

What is black when it’s clean and white when it’s dirty?
